hero.title: The Enterprise SaaS Shell You Own Outright.
hero.subtitle: Secure by design. Open source by choice. Yours outright.

features.title: The production layer indie kits never build.
features.subtitle: Fork it, own it, ship it. DevResponseKit assembles the multi-tenant foundation most teams spend weeks building — already tested and documented.

items.title: Administrator console
items.description: More than 80 pages for users, roles, a 30-key permission catalog, organizations, memberships, enterprise apps, email, and audit — with server-side search, filtering, bulk actions, and CSV export.

items.title: Three-tier access control
items.description: Superadmin, org-admin, and user tiers built on single source-of-truth scope primitives. Out-of-scope lookups return 404, so one tenant can never learn another exists.

items.title: Scoped machine API
items.description: A versioned /api/v1 with SHA-256-hashed API keys and Ed25519 JWTs verified against a published JWKS. A credential can never exceed its owner's permissions.

items.title: Cross-subdomain SSO
items.description: Single-use, 60-second nonce JWTs let users move between your apps without signing in again — backed by a registrable-origin allow-list.

items.title: Outbox-first email
items.description: Every message is recorded in an inspectable, org-scoped outbox before delivery, with pluggable Resend and Mailgun providers and editable per-locale templates.

items.title: Localized by default
items.description: next-intl with four locales and a persisted per-user preference — every route, message, and email template respects the visitor's language.

items.title: Embedded docs viewer
items.description: Markdown, Mermaid, and Shiki rendered through an XSS-hardened, sanitize-first pipeline — your documentation ships inside the app.

items.title: Security, shipped not described
items.description: HTTP security headers, PII-scrubbed observability, timing-safe secret comparison, and a CI test that fails the build if any route skips tenant scoping.

why.title: Clerk- and WorkOS-class identity, self-hosted at zero marginal cost.
why.subtitle: Organizations, three-tier RBAC, SSO, API keys, and audit are all built on open-source Better Auth — with no per-user, per-organization, or per-SSO-connection bill to compound as you grow.

items.title: Verifiable multi-tenant isolation
items.description: Tenancy is enforced at the build gate: a CI test scans every admin route and fails if one touches data without a scope primitive. Isolation becomes a guarantee you can read and run, not take on faith.

items.title: Own the code, own the data
items.description: Copy-forward source you fork and ship — no framework lock-in and no per-seat runtime fees. Self-hosted on a PostgreSQL database you control.

items.title: Tested and documented
items.description: 744 tests across unit, component, integration, security, end-to-end, and accessibility suites, plus architecture decision records and an embedded documentation site.

stack.eyebrow: Built on a stack your team already runs
stack.title: Modern, type-safe, no abstraction overhead.
